properties.displayName: SCF - AUDIT Diagnostic Settings for Key Vault to Log Analytics workspace
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to ensure that access to vaults (control plane) and access to the secrets stored in a vault (data plane) is governed through Access Control Permissions in accordance with SCF-IAM-06 Privileged Access Management and follows the principles of least privileged access.
